To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

consumer experience is not a significant factor influencing consumers' trust, while reputation, website quality, perceived usefulness, ease of use and propensity to trust have positive and significant effects on consumers' trust toward the online travel websites.

consumers' trust toward an online travel website is influenced by their propensity to trust, perceived usefulness of the website, perceived website size (i.e. perceived number of products offered by the website), ease of use, and reputation.
consumer experience is not related with consumer trust toward online websites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding consumer trust toward online websites and the factors that influence it.
the antecedents and consequences of consumer trust in the context of online travel websites.
understanding the antecedents and consequences of trust in online travel websites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the findings of this study support the proposed conceptual framework, and that consumer trust is an important determinant of consumers' intention to purchase travel products online.

the more a website is perceived as trustworthy, the more consumers are likely to develop positive attitudes toward it, the more consumers will be willing to purchase online travel, and the less perceived risk consumers will have when buying travel online.
the findings of this study provide a better understanding of the factors that drive consumer trust in the context of online travel websites and the outcomes of such trust in Egypt.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

consumers' trust toward travel websites is a function of their past experience, propensity to believe that the travel websites will perform as they say, reputation, perceived usefulness, perceived size, and perceived website quality.
the findings of this study have implications for the development of online travel industry and the e commerce industry in Egypt and other nations.
the factors that influence consumers' trust toward the online travel websites in Egypt are similar to those that have been reported in other studies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online travel websites should focus on enhancing the perceived website size and ease of use, and on developing a positive reputation.
online travel website managers need to pay attention to the antecedents and consequences of consumer trust toward online websites.
the online travel websites should focus on the quality of the website, perceived usefulness, ease of use and the reputation of the website to enhance consumer trust and intention to purchase online.
